text:
One script hammered my API and took everyone down. I had no logs to explain why.

Cross-cutting concerns aren't features — they're what keeps production survivable:

• Rate limiting — token bucket vs sliding window; protect the fleet
• Observability — logs, metrics, traces; you can't fix what you can't see
• Security — authn/authz at the edge, not bolted on later
• CDNs — serve static assets closer to users (more in an upcoming post)

These touch every service. Design them in from the start.

Wrapping up the fundamentals in my System Design series.
